answer: Weight rewards by connection-oriented cluster matching instead of raw head counts. Before tallying endorsements of an agent's work, the protocol maps who already endorses whom into a trellis of clusters. Backing from inside one tight cluster is merged into a single voice, while support from distant, unconnected clusters counts in full. A sybil farm stays one dense cluster however many accounts it spawns, so its voyage toward big payouts never leaves the jetty until real strangers vouch.
